subject: Request: short case study & metrics to support renewal/expansion
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@olivetech.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@olivetech.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short case study & metrics to support renewal/expansion

Hi Amy —

Thanks again for the time last week. As OliveTech prepares for your Q4 renewal, we want to put together a short customer-facing case study and a one-page internal impact note that the OliveTech executive team can share with procurement. The goal is to capture the concrete outcomes we delivered over the past 12 months so your renewal and the proposed expansion head into the right lanes.

Quick asks — could you confirm the following by EOD next Wednesday (21 Oct)?
- A one-line summary of the business outcome (example: "Reduced inference latency for checkout personalization by 65%")
- Two to three measurable metrics we can cite (e.g., latency improvement, cost savings per 1k requests, conversion uplift) with baseline and post-deployment numbers
- A 1–2 sentence testimonial (optional) that we can publish with your permission

I attached a very short draft of the case study and a spreadsheet template for metrics. We’ll keep the public case study brief and share the draft for approval before publishing. If you’d rather have us draft everything and ask for sign-off, happy to do that.

Next steps on our side: Evelyn (cc’d) will coordinate the legal/marketing approvals and Dylan is lined up to finalize the metric verbiage so it aligns with the renewal playbook.

Thanks — really appreciate your partnership here.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_case_study_draft_v1.docx, olivetech_metrics_q3.xlsx

Hi Marcus —

Happy to help. We’re comfortable sharing a short case study and the metrics you asked for. I pulled preliminary numbers with our analytics lead; Jasmine (cc) will drop the finalized spreadsheet by Monday. High level for now:
- Outcome line: "Improved personalization throughput and reduced latency to enable real-time shopper recommendations."
- Metrics (preliminary): latency 220ms -> 78ms (avg, 95th pct 620ms -> 190ms), estimated inference cost down ~28% per 1k sessions, A/B test showed +3.4% conversion on recommended products.

We can provide a two-sentence testimonial — I’ll draft that and Jasmine will include the procurement contacts. Small ask from my side: please keep any dollar figures out of the public case study; procurement can use them in the internal impact note.

Amy Chen
VP Product, OliveTech
amy@olivetech.com
